title: Tiny, cute anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shank -->
  <rect x="46" y="22" width="8" height="42" rx="3" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <!-- Shank highlight stripe -->
  <rect x="48" y="22" width="3" height="42" rx="1.5" fill="#B8E8F8"/>

  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#F4C842" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFE58A" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Stock (crossbar) -->
  <rect x="32" y="34" width="36" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#F4C842"/>
  <rect x="32" y="34" width="36" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE58A"/>

  <!-- Left fluke -->
  <path d="M 46 64 Q 46 82 30 82 Q 18 82 18 72 Q 18 64 30 64 Z" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <path d="M 44 67 Q 40 78 28 78 Q 22 78 22 72 Q 24 68 30 68 Z" fill="#B8E8F8"/>

  <!-- Right fluke -->
  <path d="M 54 64 Q 54 82 70 82 Q 82 82 82 72 Q 82 64 70 64 Z" fill="#7EC8E3"/>
  <path d="M 56 67 Q 60 78 72 78 Q 78 78 78 72 Q 76 68 70 68 Z" fill="#B8E8F8"/>

  <!-- Shank bottom connector -->
  <rect x="45" y="62" width="10" height="8" rx="3" fill="#F4C842"/>

  <!-- Little face on shank -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="50" r="2" fill="#FF6B9D"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="50" r="2" fill="#FF6B9D"/>
  <path d="M 47 55 Q 51 59 55 55" fill="none" stroke="#FF6B9D" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
